items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1974-01-01
items.q: Now this Judge Sondas who made the decision with Sandoz, how do you spell his name?

ctx.x: Yes. Billy Douglas and Dink Taylor, man. They would turn that shirt around. Now those two, they were characters. I found this so funny. Yeah, my wife possibly told you that. Oh yes, she did. Sure she did.
Now this Judge Sondas who made the decision with Sandoz, how do you spell his name?

That's a UNDERS, Sondas. You know his first name, don't you? No, sure. Well, then I'm sure you can find that. But these funny things come from the other side. Funny things come up like that, just the same way when we were playing in St. Petersburg, Florida, on that pier that ran out into the waters. We had an arrangement on the sheet of R.B. And as the guy would sell him the sheet of R.B., he would sell him with no pants on. Dink Taylor had to sell him to Dink Taylor to D Pensacola? No, I'm sure I didn't. It's…
